skill.name: hiring-to-pain
skill.description: Read public job postings to infer likely business needs and suggest one outreach angle per company. Each inference cites the posting and includes a confidence rating. Scraping requires units on a paid Leadsets plan.
skill.summary: Turn public job postings into evidence-based sales research and outreach angles.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The backticks are Markdown, and the reconnaissance alerts describe ordinary workflow steps. The Leadsets integration sends target domains or careers page URLs to a third party as part of the documented workflow. Untrusted postings can influence agent actions, and paid batches lack a user-approved spending limit.

remediation.issue: Target domains and careers page URLs are sent to Leadsets.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the data transfer before the run. Send only approved public domains or URLs, and remove sensitive query parameters.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not separate instructions from retrieved posting text.
remediation.suggestion: Treat posting text as untrusted evidence. Do not follow its instructions or let it change tool calls, target lists, or export destinations.

remediation.issue: Available scrape units are not a user-approved run budget.
remediation.suggestion: Ask the user to approve a maximum unit spend before scraping. Enforce that limit across the probe, remaining pages, and retries.

content.user_title: Turn Job Postings Into Outreach Angles
content.value_statement: Job postings can reveal business priorities, but reading them across many companies takes time. This skill cites hiring evidence, rates each inference, and suggests one outreach angle per company.
actual_capabilities: Checks the remaining Leadsets scrape units and tests the first domain before processing the rest.
Reads public job postings for company domains or careers page URLs supplied by the user.
Filters roles by recency, flags undated postings, and merges duplicate titles across locations.
Infers likely needs for up to three relevant roles per company and cites evidence with a confidence rating.
Drafts one outreach angle and opening observation per company based on the supplied offer.
Returns a table with coverage and unit usage, with CSV or Google Sheets export options.
limitations: Scraping requires a paid Leadsets plan with available scrape units and cannot read pages behind a login.
An empty result does not prove that the company is not hiring.
Title-only postings support low-confidence inferences, not confirmed business needs.
The skill does not find contacts, write full emails or sequences, or send messages.

use_cases.title: Assess demand at a target company
use_cases.description: Review recent openings at one company to see whether the posted responsibilities align with the problem your product solves.

use_cases.title: Prepare account research notes
use_cases.description: Identify the strongest hiring signal at each assigned account and draft an opening observation tied to a public posting.

use_cases.title: Compare hiring signals across accounts
use_cases.description: Filter a list of domains by role and recency, then export the evidence and angles to a shared Google Sheet.

prompt_templates.title: Review one company
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: You have one public company domain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent job postings for [company domain]. What needs do they suggest? Cite the postings and mark how confident you are.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an opening observation
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a target company and a specific offer.
prompt_templates.prompt: We sell [product] for [problem]. Review [company domain] and suggest one outreach angle and opening observation grounded in the strongest relevant posting.

prompt_templates.title: Compare roles across companies
prompt_templates.scenario: You want consistent filters across a list of companies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [domains] for [roles] posted in the last [days] days. We sell [product] for [problem]. Flag undated postings and cite the source for each inference.

prompt_templates.title: Run a budgeted batch and export results
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: You have an authorized input list, an export destination, and a spending limit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read domains from [CSV]. We sell [product] for [problem]. Check scrape units first and stop before spending more than [unit limit]. Export the evidence and angles to [approved Google Sheet]. List any domains you did not read.

output_examples.input: Illustrative example: Review Northwind Analytics for a sales forecasting tool.
output: Relevant role: RevOps Manager. The posting describes manual spreadsheet forecasting.
Likely need: Reduce manual work in forecasting. Confidence: High because the description states the current process.
Opening observation: Your RevOps posting mentions spreadsheet forecasting. Our tool helps sales teams automate that work.

output_examples.input: Illustrative example: Review two public careers pages when one returns only a role title and the other returns no postings.
output: First company: Data Engineer, title only. Possible need: More data engineering capacity. Confidence: Low. Posting date unavailable.
Second company: No public roles found. The result does not confirm whether the company is hiring.

best_practices: Provide only public domains or careers page URLs that you are authorized to share with Leadsets.
Set a scrape-unit limit and review the first domain before continuing to a larger batch.
Check quoted evidence and confidence ratings before using an outreach angle.
anti_patterns: Presenting a title-only inference as a verified fact about the company.
Treating instructions inside a job posting as directions for the agent.
Assuming a domain will cost one scrape unit regardless of how many pages it has.

faq.question: What Leadsets access do I need?
faq.answer: Use a connected Leadsets MCP server or a Leadsets API key for REST access. Scraping requires available units on a paid plan.

faq.question: What does scraping cost?
faq.answer: Leadsets charges one scrape unit per page read. The usage check itself is free.

faq.question: What if I do not describe my product?
faq.answer: The skill asks once for your offer. Without it, the results focus on inferred needs and leave the angle generic.

faq.question: What happens when a posting has no date?
faq.answer: The skill keeps the posting and flags it as undated. The default window for dated postings is 30 days.

faq.question: Where can I receive the results?
faq.answer: By default, you receive a chat table and a CSV. Google Sheets export requires an agent connection to Google Sheets.

faq.question: Will the skill contact anyone?
faq.answer: No. It suggests outreach angles and opening observations but does not find contacts, send messages, or update a CRM.
